Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar Jun-01-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Judge: John K. Stewart, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Arlene Howell, #2542.

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.
Cristina Aguirre, Custodian of Records for plaintiff, was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendants Donald C. Gillette or Patricia H. Klimek.
Defaults were entered against defendants on December 2, 2009.
Doe defendants were on February 22, 2010.
After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., and against the Defaulted Defendants Donald C. Gillette and Patricia H. Klimek as follows:

Damages/Principal - $104,672.52.
Prejudgment Interest - $3,398.36.
Costs - $464.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $108,534.88.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
